data.text:
Does an unchanged delta after a held-pass triage re-evaluate the gate, or refuse and burn a round?
An unchanged delta over a held-pass record is refused (exit 3) and never re-evaluates the gate after the findings get triaged
_delta_scope returns the nothing-changed refusal which _review_gate turns into exit REFUSED without recording or releasing the hold; _rounds_report pre-announces a consumed round
